title: Assessment and Evaluation of the psychometric properties of excessive media consumption, somatic stress disorders and gender incongruence in childhood and adolescence
summary:
The aim of the study is to advance the diagnosis of mental disorders in the areas of health complaints, discomfort with one's own gender and problems with excessive media consumption. Average values will be obtained that can be used to better assess the behavior of children and adolescents. This study will enable the applicability of questionnaires on health complaints, discomfort with one's own gender and problems with excessive media consumption in Germany.
Two groups will participate in the study. The clinical sample will include 300 children and adolescents aged 4 to 17 with various mental disorders and their caregivers. Additionally, a community sample with 300 children and adolescents aged 4 to 17, who will be randomly selected via Residents' Registration Office of Cologne, and their caregivers will fill out the questionnaires.
conditions: Mental disorders in children and adolescents

interventions.name: Survey of two groups: Questionaires will be filled out with prior consent.
